'''Ganron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] security [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the military forces of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. Assigned to the grounds of the [[House Thul (estate)|Thul estate]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces and his security codes stolen.
